SPOON_MONSTER_HP.title: Monster HP
SPOON_MONSTER_HP.description: Enemies have {Percent}% of their normal HP.
SPOON_MONSTER_DAMAGE.title: Monster Damage
SPOON_MONSTER_DAMAGE.description: Enemies deal {Percent}% of their normal damage.
SPOON_CARD_SET_STS1_ONLY.title: Slay the Spire 1 Cards
SPOON_CARD_SET_STS1_ONLY.description: Rewards, shops and card generation offer Slay the Spire 1 cards instead of Slay the Spire 2 ones. The Ironclad, the Silent, the Defect and the Watcher have them, and Colorless cards follow for everyone; the Necrobinder and the Regent keep their own cards.
SPOON_SPIRE_SOUVENIR_MODIFIER.title: Spire Souvenir
SPOON_SPIRE_SOUVENIR_MODIFIER.descriptio: Every character with Slay the Spire 1 cards starts with the Spire Souvenir: their rewards, shops and card generation mix Slay the Spire 1 and Slay the Spire 2 cards. The Ironclad, the Silent, the Defect and the Watcher have Slay the Spire 1 cards. A card that plays differently in each game comes as either version; card rewards let you switch.
SPOON_NEOW_BLESSING.title: Neow's Blessings
SPOON_NEOW_BLESSING.description: Neow offers its usual blessings, as in a Standard run, even with other modifiers. Modifiers that bring their own Neow option (Draft, Sealed Deck…) offer it first.
SPOON_MERCHANT_LOANS.title: Merchant Loans
SPOON_MERCHANT_LOANS.description: Co-op only. A player short of gold at the merchant can ask the others for it. Each of them can lend it, at up to 900% interest, or give it. Every gold the borrower gains afterwards repays their lenders, in equal shares, until the debt is paid. Debts survive death and resurrection until repaid or the run ends.
SPOON_ACT4.title: Act 4
SPOON_ACT4.description: The way to the Heart is open: find the Ruby, Emerald and Sapphire keys.
SPOON_CAMPFIRE_GIFT.title: Campfire Gifts
SPOON_CAMPFIRE_GIFT.description: Co-op only. At a rest site, a player can spend their action to give a card from their deck to an ally, who pays 50 gold for it. To trade, both give a card at the same fire. Curses can't be given.
SPOON_STARTING_CHEST.title: Starting Chest
SPOON_STARTING_CHEST.description: At Neow, each player opens a chest of 10 common, uncommon and rare relics from their own pool and keeps one. The starting relic stays.
